Deprecated functions and arguments

Source: R/prolfqua-deprecated.R
prolfqua-deprecated.Rd

These functions and arguments were renamed or retired in prolfqua 1.9.5. The old names still work and warn; following the policy in prolfqua-package, they call .Defunct() in a later release.

Usage

LFQDataToSummarizedExperiment(...)

LR_test(...)

lfq_power_t_test_quantiles_V2(...)

R6_extract_values(...)

list_to_AnalysisConfiguration(...)

list_to_ContrastConfiguration(...)

summary_ROPECA_median_p_scaled(...)

missigness_histogram(...)

Arguments

...

passed to the replacement function

Value

the value of the replacement function

Details

Functions:

  • LFQDataToSummarizedExperiment(): use lfqdata_to_summarized_experiment()

  • LR_test(): use lr_test()

  • lfq_power_t_test_quantiles_V2(): use LFQData$get_Stats()$power_t_test_quantiles()

  • R6_extract_values(): use r6_extract_values()

  • list_to_AnalysisConfiguration(): use list_to_analysis_configuration()

  • list_to_ContrastConfiguration(): use list_to_contrast_configuration()

  • summary_ROPECA_median_p_scaled(): use build_contrast_analysis(method = "ropeca_nested")

  • missigness_histogram() and LFQDataPlotter$missigness_histogram(): use LFQData$get_Plotter()$missingness_histogram()

Helpers unexported in prolfqua 1.9.5. They were documented only on internal help pages; each has a public route, and the deprecation warning names it. Their help pages are kept for this release.

  • LFQData methods: complete_cases(), hierarchy_counts(), summarize_hierarchy(), sample_subset() ($get_sample()), tidy_to_wide_config() ($data_wide()), table_factors() and table_factors_size() ($factors())

  • LFQData$get_Plotter(): plot_heatmap(), plot_heatmap_cor(), plot_hierarchies_boxplot(), plot_hierarchies_boxplot_df(), plot_intensity_distribution_violin(), plot_intensity_distribution_density(), plot_na_heatmap(), plot_pca(), plot_raster(), plot_sample_correlation(), pairs_smooth(), panel_cor(), missingness_histogram(), upset_missing_stats()

  • LFQData$get_Stats(): summarize_stats(), summarize_stats_quantiles(), lfq_power_t_test_proteins(), lfq_power_t_test_quantiles(), plot_stat_density(), plot_stat_density_median(), plot_stat_violin(), plot_stat_violin_median(), plot_stdv_vs_mean(), poolvar(), compute_pooled()

  • LFQData$get_Summariser(): missingness_per_condition(), missingness_per_condition_cumsum()

  • LFQData$get_Transformer(): robust_scale(), get_robscales(), scale_with_subset(), apply_to_response_matrix(), transform_work_intensity(), response_matrix_as_tibble()

  • LFQData$get_Aggregator(): estimate_intensity(), aggregate_intensity_top_n(), rank_peptide_by_intensity(), plot_estimate(), plot_hierarchies_line(), make_reduced_hierarchy_config()

  • build_contrast_analysis() and the Model and Contrasts classes: compute_contrast(), compute_lmer_contrast(), contrasts_linfct(), linfct_from_model(), linfct_matrix_contrasts(), get_complete_model_fit(), get_anova_df(), model_analyse(), model_summary(), build_model_logistf(), encode_bin_resp(), make_interaction_column(), moderated_p_limma(), moderated_p_deqms(), moderated_p_deqms_long(), summary_ropeca_median_p_scaled(), get_p_values_pbeta(), multigroup_volcano()

  • simulation helpers for tests, use sim_lfq_data_protein_config() or sim_lfq_data_peptide_config() with build_contrast_analysis(): sim_build_models_lm(), sim_build_models_lmer(), sim_build_models_logistf(), sim_make_model_lm(), sim_make_model_lmer()

  • moved to prolfquapp: script_copy_helper_vec(), separate_hierarchy()

  • get_contrast(): removed; only prolfquatakeoutmissing used it, which has its own copy

  • matrix_to_tibble(): use tibble::as_tibble(x, rownames = )

Simulator arguments of sim_lfq_data(), sim_lfq_data_peptide_config(), sim_lfq_data_protein_config() and sim_lfq_data_2factor_config():

  • Nprot: use n_proteins

  • N: use n_per_group

  • PEPTIDE: use peptide

  • TWO: use two_factor

Argument of volcano_plotly():

  • .data: use data

Argument of merge_contrasts_results():

  • model_name: never used; the merged model is named after its inputs, <prefer>_<add>
